query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM backup_reports br JOIN agents a ON a.id = br.agent_id WHERE br.acknowledged = false AND br.repo_id = ANY($1) AND br.status IN ($2, $3) AND ($4::bigint IS NULL OR br.repo_id = $4) AND ($5::int IS NULL OR br.started_at > NOW() - make_interval(days => $5)) AND a.is_hidden = false AND COALESCE(a.display_name, '') NOT ILIKE '%(imported)%'
